output.reason: [ev-5d698f8b4038] says the controller now "always" sets health.status.lastTransitionTime. That is a status field the Argo CD controller writes on Application resources, and the schema check [ev-04f25237d9d5][ev-be3337c2717d] confirms the field exists in both releases. Users do not set this field, so no spec or values setting can shield an environment. Any environment whose Application objects are reconciled by the controller can see the new behavior, so gvk-in-use argoproj.io/v1alpha1 Application is a reasonable exposure condition. The one-line changelog does not say when the field was missing before, so confidence is low.
